---
execute:
  echo: fenced
  eval: false
  output: "a note that wraps
  echo: false is just prose inside the quoted string"
  daemon: 30
  cache: refresh
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    number-sections: false
    df-print: kable
    theme: cosmo
    ipynb-shell-interactivity: null
  revealjs:
    preload-iframes: ~
---

Every nested value here renders exit 0 under `quarto render` 1.7.33, so the feature
must produce ZERO diagnostics: `execute.echo: fenced` (valid enum member),
`execute.eval: false` (valid boolean), `execute.output: "…"` (OPEN, a MULTI-LINE
DOUBLE-QUOTED scalar — quarto folds both lines into one string; the continuation line
reads `echo: false …` but is INSIDE the quote, so it must NOT be enumerated as a nested
`echo` value and flagged — the adversarial-review CRITICAL FP guard, now render-verified
exit 0), `execute.daemon: 30` (OPEN number), `execute.cache: refresh` (valid enum
member), `format.html.toc: true` / `format.html.number-sections: false` (valid
booleans), `format.html.df-print: kable` (valid enum member), `format.html.theme: cosmo`
(OPEN free string).

The last two lines are the NULL-ARM lock on the PER-FORMAT surface (document-key plan
§2.5, prerequisite P): `format.html.ipynb-shell-interactivity: null` and
`format.revealjs.preload-iframes: ~` are both grounded exit 0, yet before the `acceptsNull`
fix both were flagged — their enums list a literal `null` member that `valuesOfSchema`
drops while `closednessOfSchema` still marks the field CLOSED. `ipynb-shell-interactivity`
is the wide-reach case (it resolves on all 65 per-format surfaces); `preload-iframes` is
revealjs-scoped and also covers the `~` spelling.
